title: Groundbreaking economics at HowTheLightGetsIn
subtitle: The IAI's online festival
body:
The IAI's online festival HowTheLightGetsIn returns in September, bigger and better than ever. We'll be discussing the biggest topics from science, philosophy, politics, and the arts.

Over the weekend 19-20 September, there will be more than 200 events on eight stages, streaming live from Delhi, Londonand New York. Whatever continent you call home, you will be able to join the festival and take part in a time zone close to your own. Explore the full festival line here.

We can't wait to welcome a whole host of groundbreaking economic thinkers, including two Nobel Laureates. Speakers will include Joseph Stiglitz, Abhijit Banerjee, Grace Blakeley, Glenn Loury, Pravin Krishna, David D Friedman,Vandana Shiva and Julia Cage.

Sign up for a Latest & Library Live subscription and get six months access to IAI.tv as well as a festival ticket. Or add four months subscription to your ticket when you buy here.
